headline: Onyxia in 3:11 with no deaths
overview: One pull, 3:11 against a usual 4:26, no deaths. 29 fears, 1.2 per raider against a usual 2.6, and lava cracks hit half as often as usual. Warcraft Logs didn't hand out parses for this kill.

wentWell.text: No deaths, and fears and lava cracks at about half the usual rate.

notes.text: Lava cracks hit 11 raiders 17 times; Fenhir took 3.
